arguments.sql: SELECT c.has_chip, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.has_chip ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, c.has_chip
arguments.explanation: Shows the fraud rate over labelled transactions split by whether the card has a chip, with the transaction and fraud counts for each group.
assumptions: Same definition as the earlier query: fraud rate is fraud-labelled transactions divided by all labelled transactions, computed only over labelled rows.
has_chip is taken from the card that made each transaction (cards.has_chip, 1 = chip, 0 = no chip).
